questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: All the damn scooters. Public buses are fast, effective, and dangerously quick. A bit dangerous. No christmas break was a bit depressing too.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Kindness, and they're also pretty open.

Go to class

Hit ALTA/18 TC (Nightclubs with free entry and alcohol for students, yo!)
